summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing the declaration of its September 2026 monthly distributions across all classes of common stock, each carrying a gross distribution of $0.1380 per share with varying stockholder servicing fees yielding net amounts from $0.1197 to $0.1380. The record date is September 30, 2026, with payment on or about October 9, 2026, in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory mechanics are implicated; this is an ordinary distribution notice.
